_about: The plans of Legal Intelligence: what each one allows and what it costs. Edit this file (or point PLANS_FILE at another) and the server picks the change up within a few seconds, no restart and no code change. A file with a mistake in it is ignored as a whole and the built-in defaults (the same numbers as below) are used, so a typo can never remove a limit. A price of null means 'not set': the app shows 'price to be announced' and nothing can be bought for it. The Pro price that people actually pay still comes from PRO_PRICE_AMOUNT in the settings file (payments), and no payment for the firm plan exists: the operator puts an organisation on it by hand in the operator console.
